integrity: The proof uses an exhaustive exact census of all integer partitions through total multiplicity 17, with a bundled deterministic verifier, a machine-readable certificate, and independent direct divisor-lattice evaluations of the boundary example and the source example. Literature non-detection is not treated as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the sharp minimum total prime-factor multiplicity for odd ample integers and the three exponent signatures that can occur at that boundary. It does not classify all integers inside those signatures or any higher multiplicity layer.
title: The first multiplicity layer of odd ample numbers
